scheme_name: One-time 50% amnesty on pending motor vehicle fines
note: Kerala's one-time amnesty closed on 30 April 2026. Under G.O.(Ms) No.14/2026/TRANS, violations registered up to 31 December 2024 could be settled at half the fine — covering unlicensed driving, overspeeding, helmet/seatbelt and insurance offences, among others. The backlog it targeted was 1,02,53,151 pending violations worth ₹932.64 crore. No new window has been announced since.
